landing.headlineMain: Connect macro liquidity, project health, and your actual positions —
landing.lead: Liquidity Lens consolidates your multi-account portfolio, the macroeconomic environment (M2, CPI, Fed rates), and the development activity of the crypto protocols you hold. Four AI layers — daily briefing, contextual alerts, on-demand analysis, autonomous agents — instead of juggling five screens.

dashboard.intro: Consolidated portfolio, monitored macro, crypto projects side by side, and a daily AI briefing.
dashboard.briefingNeedPortfolio: Import a portfolio first (Portfolio tab) to get a personalized briefing.
dashboard.briefingNone: No briefing for today. The daily cron runs at 11:00 UTC (07:00 ET) — or click "Generate" to create it now.
dashboard.briefingFooter: Informational tool. Not financial advice. Data shown may be incomplete or stale.
dashboard.alertsNone: No unread alerts. The cron runs every 4 hours.
dashboard.alertsUnread: {count, plural, one {# unread alert} other {# unread alerts}}

portfolio.emptyHelp: Drop your Questrade CSV export. Multiple accounts and currencies supported; zombie positions (loss ≈ -100%) are automatically flagged.
portfolio.fxNote: Approximate FX (USDCAD={rate}). Automatic refresh in phase 2.
portfolio.importZombies: {count, plural, one {# zombie position detected} other {# zombie positions detected}} (P/L ≈ -100%).
portfolio.importFormat: Expected format: Questrade export (CSV ; separator « ; », French column headers, Latin-1 / Windows-1252 encoding). Multiple accounts per file supported.
portfolio.importNoAccount: No account detected in the file.
portfolio.unclassifiedCount: {count, plural, one {# position without a theme} other {# positions without a theme}}
portfolio.unknownLeft: {count, plural, one {# unknown (classify manually)} other {# unknown (classify manually)}}.

macro.title: Liquidity, prices, key rates
macro.intro: FRED data (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis). Daily refresh at 06:00 UTC. Global M2 aggregated across 5 zones (US, EU, JP, CN, UK), converted to USD live.
macro.noDataHelp: The daily cron hasn't run yet, or the {key} variable isn't configured. You can trigger a manual refresh via {path} after adding the key.

projects.title: Market price · development activity
projects.intro: For each tracked protocol: live CoinGecko price + GitHub metrics (commits, contributors, releases). The idea:
projects.introBold: see if the project is actually moving forward, independent of price.
projects.noDevHelp: The cron {path} hasn't run yet, or {key} is not configured. Manual trigger via {trigger}.
projects.marketError: ⚠ CoinGecko returned an error (rate limit or network). Cards will show dev data only. Reload the page in a few minutes.

analysis.title: Ask the AI
analysis.intro: The AI has access to the complete snapshot: your positions, the macro environment (M2, CPI, Fed rates), the dev activity of the protocols you track, and the upcoming catalysts. It does not give any buy or sell recommendation.
analysis.question: Your question
analysis.questionPlaceholder: e.g.: what is my Bitcoin exposure?
analysis.footer: Informational tool. Not financial advice. The user is solely responsible for their decisions.
analysis.snapshotNote: The AI receives a snapshot of your portfolio, macro, and dev activity. No buy/sell recommendation.
analysis.suggestion1: What is my actual Bitcoin exposure?
analysis.suggestion2: Which positions correlate with macro liquidity?
analysis.suggestion3: Which protocols are seeing dev activity drop off?
analysis.suggestion4: Where does my portfolio stand today?

settings.title: Alerts & AI usage
settings.intro: Configure your contextual alerts and monitor what the AI costs.
settings.alertsSubtitle: Deterministic rules on your portfolio and macro calendar. Triggers are automatically enriched by the AI (factual context — no recommendations). Checked every 4 hours.
settings.alertsEmpty: No alerts configured. You can create a set of useful defaults in one click.
settings.label: Label (optional)
settings.thresholdHint: Absolute value, fires in both directions.
settings.windowHint: Fires when a catalyst is within this window.
settings.budgetRemaining: {remaining} tokens left today. Cap configurable in DB (`profiles.ai_token_budget`).
settings.errorUnsupportedKind: Alert type not supported in V1: {kind}.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.intro: This page couldn't load. The rest of the dashboard still works — retry, or navigate elsewhere.
errors.notFoundHelp: The URL you requested doesn't exist (or no longer exists). You can go back to the home page or the dashboard.
